item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Extended Look Features 14 Songs From Phil Collins, Lil Wayne, Depeche Mode And More
item.description: Rockstar Games packed Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look with plenty to dissect, from Jason and Lucia’s criminal partnership to gunfights, driving, side activities, and a suspiciously detailed Florida-inspired world.

item.title: GTA 6 PS5 Preorders Explode After Netflix Special as PlayStation Pulls Further Ahead of Xbox
item.description: Rockstar Games’ 27-minute GTA 6 presentation sent preorders sharply higher, but the biggest winner was Sony.

item.title: GTA YouTuber TGG Talks Rockstar North Visit And GTA 6 Preview: 'A Lot More' Is Still Under Wraps
item.description: Rockstar Games apparently has far more Grand Theft Auto VI information ready to spill than its upcoming Extended Look presentation suggests.

item.title: Rockstar Games Addresses GTA 6 Gameplay Leaks: 'Heartbreaking for Our Team'
item.description: Rockstar Games has finally broken its public silence over the Grand Theft Auto VI leaks that have flooded social media during the past week.

item.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Announced at Gamescom 2026 With September Release Date, Free Upgrade, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC Support
item.description: Geralt of Rivia apparently has no interest in retirement. CD Projekt Red officially announced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Remastered during Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026, giving its 2015 RPG another substantial overhaul more than a decade after release.

item.title: Ubisoft Unveils Rainbow Six Tactics at Gamescom 2026 With Turn-Based Combat, 2027 Release Window for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC
item.description: Ubisoft used Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 to reveal Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics, a new single-player strategy game that trades the reflex-heavy firefights of Rainbow Six Siege for turn-based combat, squad management, reconnaissance, and carefully planned breaches.

item.title: GTA 6 Leak #13 Shows Enormous Vice Beach Crowds, NPC Variety and New Open-World Details
item.description: Another alleged GTA 6 gameplay leak has appeared online, and this time the main attraction is not a shootout, police chase or mission spoiler.

item.title: Nintendo Collector Loses More Than 860 NES Games Worth Up to $100,000 in Massive Home Burglary
item.description: A Nintendo collector in Washington says thieves stole more than 860 NES games from his home, wiping out a collection he spent nearly 40 years assembling and valued at between $50,000 and $100,000.

item.title: Rockstar Responds to GTA 6 Leaks as Take-Two Targets Microsoft, Discord, X and YouTube
item.description: Rockstar Games has not issued a conventional public statement about the latest GTA 6 leaks, but its parent company, Take-Two Interactive, has delivered a considerably less subtle response: copyright takedowns, federal court filings and an expanding effort to identify whoever is behind the unauthorized footage.

item.title: Some Mega Evolutions in Pokémon Legends: Z-A Locked Behind Switch Online
item.description: Getting every Mega Evolution in Pokémon Legends: Z-A might take more than patience.

item.title: Street Fighter Live-Action Movie Targets 2026 As Noah Centineo Shows Ken Physique
item.description: Noah Centineo just gave Ken fans a progress report. The The Recruit and Black Adam actor posted an Instagram shot showing the gym results he’s bringing to Capcom’s sunshine blond (see below).

item.title: Team Cherry Issues First Kickstarter Update In Six Years For Hollow Knight Fans
item.description: Kickstarter backers of Hollow Knight are finally getting Silksong codes. Straight from Team Cherry.
